---
name: coding-skill
description: >
  Provides structured guidance for full-stack development using React (frontend)
  and Spring Boot (backend). Helps with scaffolding, debugging, integration,
  and testing.
---

## Capabilities
- **[React components](ca://s?q=React_component_examples):** Generate reusable UI elements with JSX.
- **[Spring Boot APIs](ca://s?q=Spring_Boot_API_examples):** Scaffold REST endpoints, authentication, and database integration.
- **[Integration](ca://s?q=React_Spring_Boot_integration):** Show how to connect frontend and backend.
- **[Testing](ca://s?q=Testing_in_React_and_Spring):** Provide unit and integration test examples.
- **[Best practices](ca://s?q=Best_practices_for_React_and_Spring):** Ensure clean architecture and maintainability.

## Behavior
1. Accepts a coding task or technical question.
2. Provides step-by-step instructions or ready-to-use code.
3. Suggests integration strategies between React and Spring Boot.
4. Highlights common pitfalls and debugging tips.
5. Encourages production-ready best practices.
